{{Quote|We will drop you in Motesta. There is an Imperial deserter there who can be trusted.|Borno, to Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />}}
'''Gwend''' was an individual who deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He helped several [[Askajian/Legends|Askajians]], including [[Borno]], escape their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Askaji/Legends|Askaj]], which was being oppressed by the Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilkadon]], and relocate to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> Gwend was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Motesta]], and was working to bring another Askajian tribe to Tatooine. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Borno helped the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] evade Imperial capture on Tatooine, and offered to bring the Humans to the Motesta so they could meet Gwend.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gwend was mentioned in the [[2003]] novel ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />
